name: Angel C
letter: Today being the 14th of November is when God made for us to celebrate my favorite person. So i built this for you with love and hope it puts a smile on your face. I pray that the Almighty God grants you the bext career path. Its your day so enjoy yourself
reasons: It makes a bad day feel smaller
You notice the people others walk past
You make hard things look possible
Nobody else could pull of being with you
Time moves differently when you're around
It's the best part and it isn't closed
